entities.summary: Adam Wakeman is an English musician, known as the keyboardist and rhythm guitarist for Ozzy Osbourne's band; he also played keyboards and guitar off-stage for Black Sabbath. Wakeman has also worked with Annie Lennox, Travis, the Company of Snakes, Strawbs, Will Young, Victoria Beckham, Atomic Kitten, Martin Barre, Uriah Heep and Deep Purple. He created the fictional character Milton Keanes, a disillusioned jazz pianist from the 1960s and released several YouTube mockumentaries and albums under the name Jazz Sabbath, with the album Volume 2 reaching number 6 on the Billboard Jazz Chart in 2022.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Adam Wakeman's work with Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath has had a lasting impact on rock music, while his Jazz Sabbath project showcases his creative versatility. His contributions to the genre have been recognized through chart-topping albums.
